details: Bitcoin experienced a decline of over 2%, trading around $75,064, following reports of Iran's renewed closure of the Strait of Hormuz. This geopolitical development has intensified risk-off sentiment across global financial markets, leading investors to pull capital from speculative and volatile assets, including cryptocurrencies, with altcoins also recording drops.
title: Bitcoin Dips Amid Renewed Iran Conflict and Strait of Hormuz Closure

details: Despite recent macroeconomic anxieties and market dips caused by geopolitical tensions, institutional demand for cryptocurrencies remains steady. Bitcoin Exchange-Traded Funds (ETFs) recently attracted $663.91 million in inflows, pushing total net assets above the $100 billion mark. Similarly, Ether ETFs recorded $127.49 million in inflows over seven consecutive days, indicating sustained institutional interest in digital assets.
title: Institutional Inflows Continue Despite Market Volatility
